g.text: trim：window>20 条 → leftPop + rightPush 进 pending 队列「非原子，积满 batch-size(默认5) 触发 summarize」

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: summarize / consolidate：LLM 压缩 → ConsolidationRequestEvent → PgVector add「无 claim+lease，无幂等 upsert」

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: reflect：consolidation 计数 ≥ reflection-threshold(默认10) → LLM 反思 → PgVector(type=reflection) + Redis Hash UserProfile「无 provenance」

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: evict：importance<0.1 且 createdAt>180d → 直接删除「EvictionPolicyManager + 反思保护，type=reflection 豁免」

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
